rules.rationale: Base equation defining allInts on the empty ValSeq; it introduces the empty case of a structural domain predicate.
Recursive equation defining allInts on a cons cell by testing the head and descending on the tail.
Trusted simplification fact relating the existing isInt predicate to existence of an Int injection; prove.sh contains no earlier proof of this reusable rule.
Guarded defining equation for stepMax in the branch where the new integer exceeds the current maximum.
Complementary guarded defining equation for stepMax when the new integer does not exceed the current maximum.
Base equation defining rollAcc on an empty remaining sequence as the accumulated result.
Recursive rollAcc equation that appends the next prefix maximum and descends on the remaining sequence.
Owise totalization equation defining rollAcc for a non-Int head outside the intended allInts domain.
Base equation defining the rollingMax summary of an empty sequence.
Defining equation reducing rollingMax of a nonempty integer sequence to rollAcc seeded by its head.
Owise totalization equation defining rollingMax for a non-Int head outside the proved input domain.
Base equation defining foldMax on an empty remaining sequence.
Recursive equation defining foldMax by applying stepMax and descending on the tail.
Owise totalization equation defining foldMax for a non-Int head outside the allInts domain.
Base equation defining lastOr to retain its default when no elements remain.
Recursive equation defining lastOr by retaining the current head and descending on the tail.
Owise totalization equation defining lastOr for a non-Int head outside the allInts domain.

prove.sh first proves BIND-SPEC.bind-int-name with #Top using BIND-BASE, which imports only VERIFICATION-SUMMARIES and therefore excludes this VERIFICATION-CORE rule; the claim has the same guarded target-binding map transition and arbitrary continuation.

prove.sh first proves LOOP-SPEC.rolling-loop-connection with #Top using LOOP-BASE, whose closure imports VERIFICATION-CORE but excludes this VERIFICATION rule; the claim exactly matches the loop body, continuation, guard, cells, and summary transition.
